description: Search Qumge's curated catalog of agent skills (SKILL.md files) by what the user wants to accomplish. Use this whenever the user asks for a skill, tool, or Cap — e.g. 'find me a skill for social media automation', 'is there a skill for SEO audits'. Returns the best few, ranked by how useful they actually are (an LLM read each one), with a one-line summary and the exact slug to pass to get_skill.

category.description: Optional. Narrow to one category. Call list_categories to see them.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 5, max 10.

offset.description: Skip this many results — for paging through a long list.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in their own words. e.g. 'automate posting to social media', 'extract tables from PDFs'. Omit it to browse the top-ranked skills instead.

name: search_skills

category_scheme.description: Which taxonomy the results' category values come from: "domain" for browse (no query), "fine" for a search.

category.description: Category under the scheme named by category_scheme: a domain key when it is "domain", a fine category when it is "fine"; null when the entry has none.
